title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-04-09
source: Source:  Unknown Taper+Equipment>MA>Cass(Unk); Conversion: NAK Dragon>Cass>WAV>FLAC; FLAC encoding via TLH

ai_review.summary: Tape warble mars the acoustic set, but the recording still captures a powerful Dead performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers note that the electric portion of the show sounds clear and enjoyable, while the acoustic segment suffers from noticeable tape warble and other imperfections. Despite these recording flaws, the band’s energy and power shine through, earning high praise for the musical performance overall.

ai_rating.rationale: The show is praised as powerful (high show quality) but recording issues—especially tape warble on the acoustic set—lower the technical rating; combined weighting yields a solid but not outstanding score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape imperfections noted, particularly warble on the acoustic portion; electric part described as sounding nice and clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic set is hindered by tape issues, but overall performance remains strong and powerful throughout the concert.
